// REQ: LANG-1421 LANG-1422 LANG-1423
/* A simple part */
$fn = 64;
size = [20, 10, 5];

module rounded_box(dims, r = 2) {
  hull() {
    for (x = [r, dims[0] - r], y = [r, dims[1] - r])
      translate([x, y, 0]) cylinder(h = dims[2], r = r);
  }
}

difference() {
  rounded_box(size);
  translate([10, 5, -1]) cylinder(h = 10, d = 3.5);
}
echo(str("Volume: ", size[0] * size[1] * size[2]), PI, true, undef);
